newsitem.title: POLAND: Slaski down 9.9 pct after rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Slaski down 9.9 pct after rate rise.

text.p: Poland's Bank Slaski SA, 54-percent controlled by ING Bank, fell 9.9 percent on Monday in moderate trade to 176.5 zlotys on Friday's news that nominal interest rates would rise, traders said.
On Monday the lombard rate went up by two points to 27 percent and the discount rate by 2.5 points to 24.5 percent.
Large-cap BRE fell 8.2 percent on Monday but analysts said its stronger buying after price fixing signalled that any falls by banks on the rates news would be short-lived.
"It seems that such big falls represent short-term speculation -- there's no reason for that information alone to cause such a big fall by some banks," one trader said.
